nodes.label: W-259 — sixty-six goldens moved for one front-matter line
nodes.rationale: The diff is exactly two insertions: one line at Register L47 and twenty-nine at the end.

nodes.label: The cost of the ≥ 7 table living inside the Register
nodes.rationale: A one-line insertion into the Register's front matter re-banks a third of the live gate. The lesson is about cost, not correctness, and it is worth knowing before Phase 3, which will add entries at a far higher rate. Recorded, not repaired.

nodes.label: shiftcheck2.py sorted the shift — 29 EXPLAINED, 37 RESIDUE
nodes.rationale: The 29 are goldens whose every change is a Register line reference moving by exactly one — nothing read beyond the verdict, which is the tool's contract. shiftcheck.py could not have sorted this: a Register line number and a same-range count share an output line, so bumping every integer in a window breaks the count.

nodes.label: The build instrument refused rather than write a hand act
nodes.rationale: Entry 1861 took register 230 across seven citations, and a new row in the ≥ 7 table is a hand act — so the instrument refused the build, the row was written by hand, and the build was re-run.
